objective_body: Assassinate a high profile crewmember without being caught.
Be declared public enemy number one.
Deprive the station of as many @pick(stealables) as you can.
Ensure @pick(department) is @pick(affected_location) by the end of the shift.
Ensure no heads of staff @pick(escape) the station.
Ensure no members of @pick(department) @pick(escape) the station.
Ensure no @pick(rivals)s @pick(escape) the station.
Ensure no enemy spies @pick(escape) the station.
Ensure no @pick(rivals)s succeed in their objectives.
Ensure no enemy spies succeed in their objectives.
Ensure all @pick(rivals)s @pick(escape) the station.
Ensure all spies @pick(escape) the station.
Ensure all @pick(rivals)s succeed in their objectives.
Ensure all spies succeed in their objectives.
Ensure at least one @pick(rivals) leaves the shift @pick(affected_people_negative).
Ensure at least one enemy spy leaves the shift @pick(affected_people_negative).
Ensure at least one @pick(rivals) @pick(escape)s the station @pick(affected_people_positive).
Ensure at least one enemy spy @pick(escape)s the station @pick(affected_people_positive).
Frame a crewmember for a crime.
Frame the Captain for a crime.
Free the station's AI from its laws.
Interrupt the station's @pick(happenings).
Completely stop the station's @pick(happenings).
Invoke a mutiny against the heads of staff.
Invoke a mutiny in @pick(department).
Keep everyone out of @pick(department).
Make it difficult (but not impossible) to @pick(escape) the station.
Sabotage the station's power grid or engine.
Steal all the @pick(stealables) from @pick(department).
Steal as many @pick(stealables) as you can.
Take control of the station as the new Captain.
Take hostages of high value crewmembers and demand a ransom.
Terrorize @pick(department) enough to be attacked on sight.
Terrorize the crew enough to be attacked on sight.
